title: Platinum gear
description: A new gear somewhere between diamond and netherite !
body:
![platinum gear by kheyde](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/febca9a07f281488f34381151387220635e4558a.png)

This new platinum alloy will be a new step in your gear evolution between diamond and netherite! Slightly stronger than diamond and with greater durability! Platinum will be an ideal collectible and survival gear item before you upgrade to netherite!

How to find platinum ore?

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

It can be found in the overworld between layers -32 and -64! It's quite difficult to find and as rare, if not rarer, than diamond!

</details>



The mod functions exactly like vanilla gear, with raw ore, ingots, nuggets, armor, and tools/weapons.

![platinum gear](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/43ba9a0b7afd18a2a59ce534ab87a84b4a5614ef.png)
